reflection: Round 1 shows most single factors help in 2023 and 2025 but fail in 2024 (always -0.02), and gains differ by model (LR vs RF), so they look like noise-level. Near-copies of existing factors are rejected. I will try factors that capture mean-reversion/regime information that the existing return and vol features do not cover: multi-day range position, volume-price interaction, cross-sectional dispersion among peers, and the Apple-vs-QQQ beta residual. I will also fix the close-position factor by smoothing it over several days to reduce noise, and the overnight gap by scaling it by recent volatility.

lessons.name: aapl_vol_ratio_5_20
lessons.lesson: It was a near-copy of existing volatility features and a ratio of vols adds little directional information, so it failed in almost every year.

lessons.name: msft_ret_zscore_20
lessons.lesson: Z-scoring MSFT return mostly duplicated MSFT_return_1d and hurt in 2024 when MSFT lagged, so it added nothing beyond the parent.

lessons.name: aapl_close_position_range
lessons.lesson: Close location in the day's range is a noisy single-day signal that helped LR in calm-ish 2023/2025 but flipped in 2024; smoothing may stabilise it.

lessons.name: aapl_overnight_gap
lessons.lesson: The raw gap helped LR in 2022 only, probably because gap size is regime dependent (volatility scale), so it should be normalised.

lessons.name: qqq_vol_ratio_5_20
lessons.lesson: Market vol-ratio carries new information but not a directional one, and its sign of effect flipped between 2022 and 2025 regimes.

lessons.name: aapl_rel_qqq_5d_zscore
lessons.lesson: Relative 5d performance versus QQQ overlaps with Apple's own 5d returns and fails in the trending 2024 regime where relative moves did not mean-revert.

factors.name: aapl_close_position_mean3
factors.hypothesis: Single-day close position is noisy and flipped sign in 2024; a 3-day average smooths the intraday buy/sell pressure signal.

factors.name: aapl_gap_vol_scaled
factors.hypothesis: Gap helped in 2022 high-vol but failed in calm 2024; scaling by recent vol makes gaps comparable across regimes.

factors.name: aapl_range_position_20d
factors.hypothesis: Position within the 20-day high-low channel captures stretched/oversold states that mean-revert, differently from MA distance.

factors.name: peer_dispersion_1d
factors.hypothesis: When MSFT and NVDA disagree strongly, tech leadership is rotating, which may change how Apple follows the group next day.

factors.name: qqq_close_to_ma20_gap
factors.hypothesis: Combines Apple's intraday close position with the market's stretch from trend: a weak Apple close in an overextended market may reverse differently.
